rules: ChatGPT/System Architect owns production visual truth.
Claude must consume asset IDs and atlas metadata; do not hard-code source sheet coordinates.
Do not recolor/crop/redraw approved R2 assets without a new visual revision.
Avatar is rendered as a circular masked layer at each dancer asset headSocket.
Per-asset headSocket is authoritative; no global socket fallback when metadata exists.
Runtime prefers WebP atlases; individual PNG/WebP files are source/fallback package.
